title: Runtime Task Object v0.1
description: Task schema for Layer-3 runtime. A task is a runtime-owned, bounded unit of work that flows through the governed agent loop. Granularity: one task = one inbound request for v0.1.

schema_version.description: Schema version for validation and migration.

task_id.description: Runtime-owned task identity. Generated by runtime; NOT required to be deterministic. Unique per runtime instance.

task_kind.description: Classification of task type. execution=governed runtime execution, ask=plan-only (no sandbox), ingestion=from external source, evaluation=M3.18 harness.

request_id.description: Inbound request identifier. Links task to originating request for ledger join.

session_id.description: Session/user context identifier. Matches plan.v0.1 and ledger_row.v0.1 for correlation.

source_surface.description: Origin surface for provenance and routing. ide_execute=JetBrains/VS Code plugin execute, ide_ask=plugin ask, api_execute=API endpoint, ingestion=M3.12-M3.16 pipeline, replay=ledger reconstruction.

root_path.description: Repository root path for context engine.

revision.description: Git revision / commit SHA for deterministic context.

repo_scope.description: Repository targeting for deterministic context linkage.

plan_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the linked plan.v0.1 object. Set when plan is created.

expected_phase.description: NON-AUTHORITATIVE HINT ONLY. The authoritative phase is in the plan. This field is for routing/observability convenience and MUST NOT be used for governance decisions.

governance_ref.description: Linkage to governance (plan). Does NOT duplicate plan body. expected_phase is a non-authoritative hint only.

constraints.description: Execution limits for fail-closed loop safety.

test_refs.description: References to test files/paths for evaluation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Evaluation anchor for M3.18. DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Does NOT contain executable harness logic or procedural evaluation commands.

current_state.description: Current agent loop state. Must align with state_enums.v0.1.agent_state.

stop_reason.description: Reason for entering terminal state. Must align with state_enums.v0.1.stop_reason.

terminal_at_utc.description: Timestamp when task entered terminal state. Set once, never cleared.

created_at_utc.description: Task creation timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC.

updated_at_utc.description: Last mutation timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC.

parent_task_id.description: Optional parent task ID for forward-compatibility. NOT used for multi-task orchestration in v0.1.

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Namespaced extension objects. Each namespace must be a lowercase identifier.

metadata.description: EXTENSION SURFACE ONLY. Must be namespaced (e.g. 'ide_context': {...}, 'debug': {...}). NOT a substitute for first-class fields. NOT an unbounded junk drawer.

_design_notes.granularity: v0.1 enforces one task = one inbound request. Multi-task decomposition is out of scope.
_design_notes.task_id_determinism: task_id is runtime-generated identity. It is NOT required to be deterministic from inputs.
_design_notes.expected_phase: governance_ref.expected_phase is a NON-AUTHORITATIVE HINT. Authoritative phase is in plan.v0.1.
_design_notes.acceptance_criteria: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Does not encode executable harness config or procedural logic.
_design_notes.metadata: Constrained to namespaced extension objects. Keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ pattern.
_design_notes.boundaries: Task links to plan via plan_hash; does not contain plan body. Task produces ledger rows; does not contain them.
